payload.sql: WITH ranges AS (  SELECT pg_range.rngtypid, pg_type.typname AS rngtypname,         pg_type.typarray AS rngtyparray, pg_range.rngsubtype    FROM pg_range LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_type ON pg_type.oid = pg_range.rngtypid)SELECT pg_type.typname, pg_type.typtype, pg_type.oid, pg_type.typarray,       ranges.rngtypname, ranges.rngtypid, ranges.rngtyparray  FROM pg_type LEFT OUTER JOIN ranges ON pg_type.oid = ranges.rngsubtype WHERE (pg_type.typtype IN('b', 'e'));
